title: IVG Pro Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml E-Liquid offers a bright and refreshing tropical getaway in every draw. This perfectly balanced recipe captures the distinctive, tangy sweetness of freshly sliced Pineapple, providing a rich and juicy base layer. To counter the natural sweetness of the fruit, a sharp, cooling layer of Ice washes over the palate on the finish, leaving a remarkably clean and frosty exhale. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the tropical refreshment of Pineapple Ice, vapers can explore other standout options such as the botanical smoothness of Spearmint or the nostalgic taste of Hub Blast, ensuring a premium choice for every preference.
